title: Densities of the restricted blow-up at points whose image has a density
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N, x ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0, R ∈ ℝ, c ∈ [0,∞] with c ≠ ∞, and θ ∈ [0,∞]. Let W be an n-varifold on the open ball B°_R(0) with W.measure = c • (rescaledMeasure V x t)⌞(B°_R(0) × G(N,n)), and let y ∈ B°_R(0) satisfy HasDensity n μ_V (x + t•y) θ. Then HasDensity n μ_W y (c·θ).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (t R : ℝ) (c θ : ℝ≥0∞) (W : Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R)) (y : Euclidean N), 0 < t → c ≠ ∞ → W.measure = c • (rescaledMeasure V x t).restrict (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → y ∈ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R → HasDensity n V.weight (x + t • y) θ → HasDensity n W.weight y (c * θ)
